lines.text: A big long neck!
A bone is white with two bumpy ends!
A dino bone! You're a real fossil finder!
A dinosaur stomped through the valley! Follow the trail and count everything it left behind. Big numbers ahead!
A great big T. rex!
A little dino!
An egg!
Bones on the trail! Count them all!
Can you find the T. rex?
Chomp! T. rex eats meat!
Count both groups!
Count both sides carefully!
Count carefully! Which group has eight eggs?
Count carefully, then find the nest with that number!
Count down for the volcano! Three comes first!
Count each side! More means a bigger number!
Crack! It's hatching!
Dinner time! Who eats what?
Dino diggers look for bones! Can you find one?
Dinosaurs are hiding in the valley! When I call one, tap it as fast as you can!
Egg, hatchling, big dino! It grew up!
Eight eggs! What a big nest!
Eight is a lot! Count each egg!
Every big dinosaur starts as a tiny egg! Tap the pictures in order to watch a dino grow up.
Fewer means the smaller group!
First one! Find the T. rex!
Five leaves! The long necks will feast!
Five stomps! Stomp, stomp, stomp!
Five!
Five, four, three, two, one... BOOM! The dinos all cheered!
Footprints! Tap each one and count!
Four big stomps! A dinosaur walked here!
Four is more than one! Stomp, stomp!
Four!
From tiny egg to mighty T. rex! Roar!
Hooray! You finished every adventure on Dino Valley! You are a true Star Explorer!
How does a dino grow? The egg comes first!
It's the great dino quiz! Show me everything you've learned, Explorer. The dinosaurs are all watching!
Last one! Find the rumbly volcano!
Last one! Which side has fewer eggs?
Leaves! Munch, munch, munch!
Look at both nests! Which has more eggs?
Look for the neck that reaches way up high!
More eggs! Tap and count them all!
Munch! The long neck loves leaves!
Nine is more than six! Amazing counting!
Now count down from five!
Now find the dinosaur with the long, long neck!
Now watch a T. rex grow! Start with the egg!
One!
Roar! That's the T. rex!
Roar! You found the T. rex!
Seven eggs! Can you count that high?
Seven eggs! That's a whole dino family!
Six dino bones! What a find!
Snap! The crocodile catches a fish!
Some nests are full and some are almost empty! Look at both sides and tell me which has more, and which has fewer.
TEN stomps! You did it, Explorer! All the dinosaurs are roaring for you!
Tap each egg and count!
Tap each footprint and count to five!
Ten is the biggest! Count every footprint!
That's the egg! Shhh, a baby dino is sleeping inside!
The T. rex stands tall with big teeth!
The T. rex stands up tall with big teeth!
The biggest count of all! Find ten footprints!
The butterfly sips the sweet flower!
The dinosaurs are hungry! Drag each snack to the friend who loves it most.
The egg is safe and cozy in the nest!
The egg is smooth and white, not bumpy like a rock!
The little lizard catches the bug!
The long neck reaches up high for green food!
The long necks are hungry! Which side has more leaves?
The mama dinos are sorting their nests! Count what's in each group, then drag it to the right nest.
The volcano is getting rumbly! Tap the numbers from biggest to smallest and count down to the big boom!
The volcano is the mountain with hot orange lava on top!
The volcano! Rumble, rumble, boom!
Three bones!
Three eggs! The mamas will be so happy!
Three is fewer than six! Fewer means less!
Three leaves!
Three long necks!
Three!
Three, two, one... BOOM! Rumble rumble!
Tricky one! Which side has fewer bones?
Two T. rexes!
Two dino eggs! Wobble, wobble!
Two eggs!
Two footprints!
Two is fewer than four! You've got it!
Two!
Welcome to Dino Valley! Tap a glowing level to play!
Welcome to Dino Valley, Explorer! The dinosaurs left eggs everywhere! Tap each one and count with me.
What does the long neck dinosaur love to eat?
Where is the dinosaur egg hiding?
Which group has more bones?
Which side has more footprints?
Which side looks fuller?
Wow! A new world just landed: Dino Valley! Let's go explore!
Yes! Five eggs is more than two!
Yes! Its neck is long like a slide!
